verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a priority service tier (service_tier="priority") that it says gives faster time-to-first-token and higher throughput during peak demand. It also offers dedicated autoscaling instances on high-end GPUs. However, the speed claim is qualitative and tied to peak-demand prioritization on supported models, and a community comment notes cold-start latency can reach up to about 10s on less popular models. missing for 10: published TTFT/tokens-per-second figures or benchmarks, independent hands-on latency corroboration, guarantees beyond 'during peak demand' on 'supported models'.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve latency-sensitive workloads with fast time-to-first-token and high-throughput generation

citations.quote: Set service_tier to "priority" to request priority inference on supported models. Priority requests get faster time-to-first-token and higher throughput during peak demand.
Deploy a dedicated instance on A100/H100/H200/B200/B300 with autoscaling and a private endpoint
